standard_prerequisites.use: The naive cotangent complex of a ring map and of a morphism, presentations, and sheafification; the comparison is retained.

core_obligations: Construct the canonical comparison map from the sheafified naive cotangent complex of the ring map to the restriction of the complex of the morphism.
Show the comparison is a quasi-isomorphism by comparing presentations and sheafifying.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the affine chart and the two complexes.

difficulty_reason: For affine opens U of the source and V of the target with U mapping into V, the lemma produces a canonical map from the sheafified naive cotangent complex of the corresponding ring map to the restriction of the naive cotangent complex of the morphism, and shows it is a quasi-isomorphism. The proof compares the two complexes on the affine chart, uses the description of the naive cotangent complex through a presentation of the ring map, and verifies that the comparison is an isomorphism in the derived category. Verifying the quasi-isomorphism after sheafification is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 3747-3774.
